description: This file defines the Voucher controller class in the OpenCart system, specifically for handling total voucher logic in the checkout process. It includes methods for displaying and saving voucher data and interacts with session data, models, language, and URLs within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for managing voucher-related operations in the total module extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the voucher form or page if the voucher total is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves voucher data sent via POST, updates session data, and returns JSON response.
